findings.comment: Demolition plan sequence notes (Sheet 8, Block 9) do not address required safety clearances from transmission lines. Missing: (1) pre-construction safety meeting requirement ≥48 hours before commencement with Austin Energy; (2) barricade requirement 10 feet from all transmission structures, including guys and anchors; (3) warning signs under overhead transmission facilities; (4) prohibition on materials and spoils storage within the transmission easement. Current notes only reference Environmental Inspector meeting and utility abandonment.

Demolition plan (Sheet 8) Site Demolition Notes do not address required transmission line safety clearances detailed in Sheet 3 Electric Transmission Notes. Missing: (1) pre-construction safety meeting requirement with Austin Energy 48 hours before work commencement, (2) barricade requirement 10 feet from transmission structures, (3) warning signs under overhead transmission facilities, and (4) prohibition on materials or spoils storage within transmission easement.
applicableAreas: Demolition activities adjacent to transmission easement and transmission structures

findings.comment: Demolition plan notes do not address required safety clearances from transmission lines: pre-construction safety meeting with Austin Energy 48 hours before work commencement, barricades erected 10 feet from transmission structures, warning signs under overhead facilities, and prohibition on materials or spoils storage within transmission easement. Sheet 3 (General Notes) specifies transmission facility requirements but Sheet 8 demolition notes (Block 9, 10 items) do not reference or incorporate these safety requirements.

Submit copies of all required licensing documentation for any structures, paving, or landscaping proposed within recorded easement boundaries before approval.

findings.comment: Transformer Pad 3 is positioned less than 5 feet (nearly flush) against the exterior wall of Unit 801, violating the minimum 10-foot clearance requirement from any adjacent building or structure per UCM § 1.10.4(hot-stick/padlocked side). Transformer Pad 2, located in the tight corridor between Units 404 and 504, also appears to be positioned less than 10 feet from building exteriors. Additionally, no dedicated AE easement is shown on the site plan to encumber the transformer pad areas as required. Relocate transformer pads to satisfy minimum 10-foot clearance from all adjacent structures, and provide a dedicated AE easement plat encumbering the pad locations.
applicableAreas: Transformer Pad 3 (west of Unit 801); Transformer Pad 2 (between Units 404 and 504)

Transformer Pad 2 (east side, between Buildings 4 and 6)
